business_problem: Bayer Crop Science needed agronomic advisors to answer highly technical crop and product questions faster, but the expertise was spread across decades of agronomy content, product research, proprietary insights, spreadsheets and tables that were difficult to search, synthesize and apply in the moment.
solution_summary: Bayer Crop Science worked with EY professionals and Microsoft to build a proof-of-concept generative AI assistant for agronomic advisors. The team grounded a large language model in Microsoft Azure with decades of aggregated agronomy content, product research data and proprietary insights, then translated legacy spreadsheets and tabular sources into structures the model could understand. Additional algorithms reformatted information from different sources into digestible data so the assistant could answer detailed natural-language agronomy and product questions. Retrieval Augmented Generation and prompt engineering were used to retrieve relevant context in real time and improve response quality, while an automated validation process compared outputs against subject-matter experts and open-source LLMs. The system gave Bayer a reusable knowledge layer that could support employees, partners and customer-facing interactions.

solution_components.name: large language model (LLM)
solution_components.role: Processes agronomy questions and generates responses using Bayer's grounded content.

solution_components.name: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)
solution_components.role: Dynamically retrieves relevant agronomy context so the assistant can answer questions in real time.

solution_components.name: automated validation process
solution_components.role: Scores and checks answers against subject-matter experts and other models before broader rollout.

data_flow: Agronomy content, product research data, proprietary insights, spreadsheets and tables were normalized and loaded into an Azure-based LLM stack. RAG retrieves relevant passages at query time, prompt engineering shapes the answer, and automated validation compares outputs with open-source models and subject-matter experts before advisors use the results.
business_outcome: Bayer Crop Science proved that a grounded GenAI assistant could make agronomic knowledge easier to retrieve, help advisors answer questions faster and more completely, and extend into training, marketing and future multilingual farmer support as confidence in the system grew.
metrics: proof of concept built in just 90 days
